description: Fetch complete details for a specific CielStay listing: full description, all photos, amenities, house rules, exact location, and every booking link including the host's own direct booking site. Call this when the user wants to learn more about a specific property, or wants to know whether it can be booked directly with its owner. Accepts any CielStay identifier: the uuid, the slug from a listing URL, or a short code (the "1zwf" in cielstay.com/l/1zwf).

id.description: The listing ID from a previous search result (result.id).

name: get_listing_details
